justification: Historical High: extract-zip@2.0.1 was present via @electron/packager 18.x and @puppeteer/browsers 2.x. No patched extract-zip release existed, so ADR 0008 allowed a time-boxed MERGE_ONLY exception while promotion stayed blocked. Controller-authorized Option A removed the unscoped extract-zip package by overriding @electron/packager to 20.3.0 (Forge 7.11.2 retained) and @puppeteer/browsers to 3.2.3 (WDIO 9.x retained). This manifest must not ignore CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv. Independent QA has not accepted P02-AUDIT-006.
compensating_controls: Unscoped extract-zip package must remain absent from package-lock.json and tests/desktop-e2e/package-lock.json
ISR-015 fails if extract-zip reappears in either npm graph
CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv must not appear in infra/security/trivy-merge.ignore
@electron-internal/extract-zip is a different npm package and is not treated as extract-zip without a matching advisory
